title: BACE: Safety & Workplace Culture - Biotechnology - PPE Selection
subject: Biotechnology

questions.q: Which type of glove is generally recommended for handling a wide range of organic solvents, such as acetone or chloroform, when standard latex gloves would degrade rapidly?
questions.explain: Nitrile gloves offer superior chemical resistance to many organic solvents compared to latex or vinyl. However, for specific highly aggressive chemicals, the SDS must always be consulted to verify glove compatibility.
questions.subject: Biotechnology

questions.q: Which of the following footwear is acceptable in a laboratory setting?
options: Closed-toe, closed-heel shoes covering the entire foot
questions.explain: Lab shoes must fully cover the foot to protect against spills and falling sharps. Sandals, open-toed shoes, and mesh materials (which allow liquids to soak through) are prohibited.
